description:
Hushfeed v0.71.0 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

47.1.4 is still the only supported version, so patch that APK with your usual signing key.

Mostly fixes for things you reported. The For You progress bar is back, a collection plays the video you tapped, animated comment stickers move again and long creator names stop getting cut short. Two new patches keep the TikTok language you picked and let you sign in without a passkey. The music disc can spin again, Double tap can do anything Long press does, and LIVE quality can be picked in more rooms.

Simple mode picks 115 patches. Skip the splash ad, Skip update checks, Limit background traffic, Drop the animated image cache, Stop on-device AI profiling and Enable voice comments now have a switch that starts off, so turn yours on after you update. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 3871 runtime tests passed and 765 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 132 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The bundle was also patched onto a phone with TikTok 47.1.4, where the double tap fix was checked.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
